messages:
Lena: Heads up  Marco handed in his resignation this morning, final day Fri 2026-06-12. He has access to a sensitive client vault and owns a short-lived data migration. We need a tight plan for secrets rotation and a clean exit.
Marco: Confirmed. I'll finish the migration runbook and tag any credentials in Vault. Happy to do an extended handoff Thu.
Ivy-IT: Proposed plan:
- 09:00 final day: Slack set to Away and calendar blocked
- 11:00 final day: repo write perms revoked, CI deploy tokens rotated
- 13:00 final day: rotate client vault paths Marco owns, revoke app grants
- 14:00 final day: deactivate Okta + VPN
- 14:05 final day: rotate any infra service keys and remove user from infra groups
Commands I'll run (audit attached to JIRA):
```
# Vault rotate
vault kv get -format=json secret/clients/zephyr/marco
vault kv metadata-delete secret/clients/zephyr/marco
vault kv put secret/clients/zephyr/service new_key=@newcreds.json
# Okta
oktactl deactivate-user --user marco
# AWS
aws iam remove-user-from-group --group-name Engineers --user-name marco
```
Diego-Sec: Security checklist: snapshot active sessions and list all API keys before rotation, export last 45 days of auth logs for client work, and confirm no long-lived tokens remain in third-party apps. If Marco used any shared service accounts, we'll rotate those immediately and update runbooks.
Samira-HR: COBRA/tax note: COBRA notice will be sent 2026-06-13. Benefits termination date on record is 2026-06-26. Final payroll processes 2026-06-19 and includes PTO payout. Exit interview scheduled Mon 2026-06-15 09:30 (invite sent). Marco, do you want the COBRA packet emailed or mailed?
Marco: Email is fine. I've uploaded the migration runbook and outstanding ticket list: https://drive.redwood.com/handovers/marco-runbook.pdf. Vault paths I used are noted in section 2.
Lena: I created the offboard ticket OFFBOARD-3098 in JIRA and linked the Notion checklist. Please attach any audit outputs.
offboard-bot: Reminder  attach proof of rotations and entitlement report to OFFBOARD-3098 before closing.
Ivy-IT: Executed rotations at 2026-06-12T13:10Z. Posted vault deletion and new service secrets to JIRA.
Diego-Sec: Verified entitlement report  no remaining Okta groups or AWS roles. Found one legacy token in a third-party monitoring app; rotated and updated creds. Uploaded logs for 45-day window.
Samira-HR: COBRA notice delivered via email. Final paycheck scheduled and HR tax docs mailed. Exit interview completed  Marco opted into alumni updates.
Marco: Laptop dropped at HQ reception Thu morning. Thanks for the smooth process, team.
Lena: Confirming OFFBOARD-3098 moved to Done after all artifacts and receipts attached. Closing loop  thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
